caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a lidded drinking tankard with the lid open. The tankard has a cylindrical body with a base that is slightly wider than the main body and features two parallel lines near its bottom edge. The handle is attached to the right side, elegantly curved, and detailed with a small ornamental pattern near where it meets the tankard body and a thumb piece for opening the lid. The lid is circular, shown open, and attached by a hinge at the top of the handle. There is a decorative thumb lift on top of the lid. The drawing is executed in fine black ink lines on an off-white, slightly yellowed paper. At the bottom right corner, the name "Lawrence Flynn" is signed in cursive script. The image has no shading, with all detail rendered using line work only.
title: Silver Tankard
